notes:
I don't have any notes on Jeremiah 42 for you yet, because none of the research worked.

I tried to read six verse-by-verse sources at once: Enduring Word, Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub, Precept Austin, and the NET Bible notes. My code crashed while reading the replies, so I never saw what any of the pages said. Then the tool cut me off for this turn, so I couldn't try again or run any searches.

You asked me to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. So I haven't written any verse notes, tradition comparisons or "other views."

**If you send the request again, I'll:**
1. Re-read those six sources, fixing the crash.
2. Look for Reformed, Baptist, Methodist, Pentecostal and Lutheran teachers who comment on the main verses. Likely ones are vv. 5–6 (the people's vow to obey), v. 10 (God "relenting") and v. 20 (they "deceived yourselves").
3. Check the Catholic and Orthodox sites, and the NET Bible's study notes.
4. Write the notes verse by verse, with a URL after every point.
